issues.message: Actual helper validate and same-folder export both exited 0; round-1 evidence is saved. Semantic payload review then found two material implementation ambiguities below.

CTX4/C1/C4 did not give one exact typed manifest object or exact config-digest key set, yet C4 delegated the manifest to CTX4. Different implementers could serialize different identity/config/count fields. Specify exact fields/canonical JSON and validate full stored binding before a no-op/completion.

C4 reused one staging path across its allowed retry after proven absence, so an orphan first-attempt staging directory could block EV15 despite the designed retry. Also EV27 expected explicit reconciliation for a signal after rename start without an explicit C4 output rule. Give attempt-specific stage paths and a precise post-start cancellation outcome.
